AboutPage.heroDesc: We are a team of passionate designers and developers building premium digital experiences for businesses worldwide. From Ho Chi Minh City to the world.
AboutPage.storyP1: LOOP was founded in 2016 with a simple mission: to help businesses thrive in the digital world through exceptional web design and development. What started as a small freelance operation has grown into a full-service digital agency with over 50 team members.
AboutPage.storyP2: Over the past 8+ years, we have delivered 150+ projects for clients across 30+ countries — from startups launching their first website to enterprises building complex multi-branch systems and custom web applications.
AboutPage.storyP3: Our philosophy is simple: every project deserves world-class quality. We combine cutting-edge technology (React, Next.js, TypeScript) with thoughtful design to deliver solutions that don't just look great — they perform, convert, and scale.
AboutPage.valuesSub: The principles that guide everything we do
AboutPage.val1Desc: Every design decision and line of code is optimized to deliver measurable business outcomes for our clients.
AboutPage.val2Desc: We treat your project like our own. Your success is our success, and we go above and beyond to deliver.
AboutPage.val3Desc: We stay at the cutting edge of web technologies to give your business a competitive advantage.
AboutPage.val4Desc: 95+ Lighthouse scores, WCAG accessibility, and security best practices are non-negotiable in every project.
AboutPage.techSub: We use the best tools to build the best products
AboutPage.ctaSub: Let's discuss your project and find the perfect solution for your business.

PricingPage.heroDesc: Simple, transparent pricing for every business size. No hidden fees, no surprises — just exceptional value.
PricingPage.comparisonDesc: Compare all features across packages to find the perfect fit.
PricingPage.hostingDesc: High-performance hosting and professional domain solutions for your website.
PricingPage.deploymentDesc: Full transparency on what you own after project completion.
PricingPage.faq1_q: What is included in the starting price?
PricingPage.faq1_a: The starting price covers design, development, and deployment of your project. It includes all listed features for each plan, plus 1-12 months of post-launch support depending on your package.
PricingPage.faq2_q: Can I upgrade my plan later?
PricingPage.faq2_a: Absolutely! You can upgrade at any time. We'll credit your original investment toward the new plan and add the additional features seamlessly.
PricingPage.faq3_a: Yes. After the included support period ends, we offer monthly maintenance plans for updates, security patches, and performance monitoring.
PricingPage.faq4_q: What if my project needs custom requirements?
PricingPage.faq4_a: Contact us for a quote. We build fully custom solutions tailored to your specific business needs, timeline, and budget.
PricingPage.faq5_q: What payment methods do you accept?
PricingPage.faq5_a: We accept bank transfers, credit cards via Stripe, and PayPal. We typically require 50% upfront and 50% upon completion.
PricingPage.faq6_q: What is required to register a .vn domain?
PricingPage.faq6_a: Vietnamese .vn and .com.vn domains require the owner's business license (GPKD). We'll guide you through registration with reputable providers like PA Vietnam, Mat Bao, or Nhan Hoa.
PricingPage.ctaDesc: Every business is unique. Contact us for a tailored proposal that fits your specific requirements and budget.

ServicesPage.heroDesc: From simple landing pages to enterprise-grade web applications — we deliver solutions that drive real business growth.
ServicesPage.step1Desc: We learn about your business, goals, and project requirements in detail.
ServicesPage.step2Desc: We create a custom proposal with timeline, tech stack, and transparent pricing.
ServicesPage.step3Desc: Our team designs and develops your solution with regular progress updates.
ServicesPage.step4Desc: We deploy your project and provide ongoing support and maintenance.
ServicesPage.faq1_q: How long does it take to build a website?
ServicesPage.faq1_a: A standard business website takes 2-4 weeks. E-commerce platforms take 4-8 weeks. Custom web applications may take 2-3 months depending on complexity.
ServicesPage.faq2_a: Yes, we handle all deployment and can manage your hosting on Vercel, AWS, or your preferred provider.
ServicesPage.faq3_q: Will my website be mobile-friendly and SEO optimized?
ServicesPage.faq3_a: Absolutely. Every website we build is fully responsive and follows modern SEO best practices to ensure high visibility.
ServicesPage.faq4_q: Do I own the source code?
ServicesPage.faq4_a: Yes. Once the project is fully paid for, you have 100% ownership of the final source code and assets.
ServicesPage.faq5_q: Can you design the UI/UX as well?
ServicesPage.faq5_a: Yes, our team includes expert UI/UX designers who will create a stunning, user-friendly interface for your project.

PrivacyPage.heroDesc: At LOOP, we take your privacy seriously. This Privacy Policy describes how we collect, use, and protect your personal information when you use our website and services.
PrivacyPage.section1P1: We collect information you provide directly, such as your name, email address, phone number, and company details when you submit a contact form, request a quote, or create an account.
PrivacyPage.section1P2: We also automatically collect certain information when you visit our website, including your IP address, browser type, device information, and browsing behavior through cookies and similar technologies.
PrivacyPage.section2P1: We use the collected information to:
PrivacyPage.section2Item2: Communicate with you about projects and inquiries
PrivacyPage.section2Item3: Send relevant updates and marketing materials (with your consent)
PrivacyPage.section2Item4: Analyze website performance and user experience
PrivacyPage.section3P1: Our website uses cookies and similar tracking technologies to improve your experience:
PrivacyPage.section3Item1: Google Analytics — for website traffic analysis
PrivacyPage.section3Item3: Essential cookies — for basic site functionality
PrivacyPage.section3Item4: You can control cookie preferences through your browser settings
PrivacyPage.section4P1: We do not sell, trade, or rent your personal information to third parties.
PrivacyPage.section4P2: We may share information with trusted service providers who assist us in operating our website and business, subject to strict confidentiality agreements.
PrivacyPage.section5P1: We implement industry-standard security measures to protect your personal information:
PrivacyPage.section5Item1: SSL/TLS encryption for all data transmission
PrivacyPage.section5Item2: Secure data storage with regular backups
PrivacyPage.section5Item3: Regular security audits and vulnerability assessments
PrivacyPage.section6P1: You have the right to access, correct, or delete your personal information at any time.
PrivacyPage.section6P2: You may also opt out of marketing communications. To exercise these rights, please contact us at hello@loop.vn.
PrivacyPage.section7P1: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. We will notify you of any significant changes by posting the new policy on this page with an updated effective date.
PrivacyPage.section8P1: If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy, please contact us:
PrivacyPage.section8Item3: Address: Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
